lines.text: Morning. Two weeks since the hip replacement, how are you doing?
Not bad. I'm coming in with the wound a bit red at the bottom end, mind.
Let me have a look. It's clean and dry, slightly pink at the lower end, no discharge, so that's healing as it should.
When did you last take the blood thinner injection?
No, this morning at eight, my husband did it before breakfast.
Good. Keep doing those until the full 28 days are up.
Let's see you walk. Nice, you're using the frame well, try to step through rather than bringing the feet together.
I've had some tingling and an ache in my left calf since yesterday, is that normal?
Let me check. The calf's soft and not swollen, but I'm not happy leaving it, so I want you to see a GP today for a scan to rule out a clot.
If you get chest pain or feel short of breath, call 999 straight away.
It's most likely nothing, but better safe.
